faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kerala High Court Various Posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Kerala High Court Various Posts is 03-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Outreach Worker post?
faq.answer: For the Outreach Worker position, candidates must have passed their 12th grade and possess relevant experience in the health sector. Detailed qualifications are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited candidates will range from ₹123700 to ₹166800 per month, depending on the specific post and experience.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Kerala High Court Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the positions.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of ₹1000/- is applicable for all categories of candidates applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the posts is between 21 and 35 years. However, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years over and above the maximum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Kerala High Court Various Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Candidates need to prepare their bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
